spanish: Y vio Moisés al pueblo, que desatado él, porque lo desató Aarón a vergüenza entre sus levantados.

findings.issue: H8103 is a feminine noun of scornful whispering/derision; vergüenza substitutes the distinct concept shame.
Qal active participle (those who rise) is rendered as the passive participle levantados, reversing who acts.

notes: The other tokens match in participants, number, and stem, including passive פרע versus active פרע with a 3ms suffix.
